items.name: Borrowed Time Pouch
items.description: A velvet pouch containing two seconds of someone else's afternoon. The System insists they will not miss it.
items.synergy_notes: Clock-runner build. Recharges on room clears, never on wall-clock time, so waiting in a room cannot farm ticks.

items.name: Floor-Stomp Subwoofer
items.description: A speaker cabinet with the bass turned past where the dial was supposed to stop. The floor tiles disapprove.
items.synergy_notes: Panic button for melee builds: damage plus slow around you. Clumps enemies for cleave weapons.

items.name: Inflatable Fan Club
items.description: A life-sized inflatable cut-out of you, holding a sign that says 'Hit me instead'. Monsters are, mercifully, illiterate.
items.synergy_notes: Ranged/kiter safety valve: break line of aggro, reposition, keep shooting.

items.name: Customer Safety Button
items.description: Pressing it summons a shimmering barrier and a recorded voice saying 'Your safety is very important to us'.
items.synergy_notes: Generic defensive active usable by every build.

items.name: Hi-Vis Hazard Vest
items.description: Highly visible. Monsters can see you coming from three rooms away. On the other hand, so can the medics. There are no medics.
items.synergy_notes: Juggernaut staple. Stacks with Iron Gut for a tanky STR build.

items.name: Knockoff Running Shoes
items.description: The logo is a swoosh going the wrong way. The soles are cardboard. You have never run faster in your life.
items.synergy_notes: Kiter and bleeder mobility. Dodging grants haste; pairs with Sidestep Protocol.

items.name: Serrated Lanyard
items.description: Your sponsor badge now hangs from a strip of razor wire. Networking has never been so cutting-edge.
items.synergy_notes: Bleed build: melee hits stack bleeding, which turns on Open Wounds' bonus damage.

items.name: Lighter-Fluid Bandolier
items.description: Twelve tiny bottles of accelerant strapped across your chest. Fire safety officers would like a word. They are all on fire.
items.synergy_notes: Arsonist build: ranged hits ignite. Scattergun pellets and staples roll separately, so they ignite often.

items.name: Ricochet Floor Wax
items.description: Industrial-grade polish applied to every projectile you own. They now glide through the first thing they hit, out of sheer momentum.
items.synergy_notes: Kiter build: +1 pierce on all projectiles. Best with the crossbow or staple rifle.

items.name: Spite Battery
items.description: Stores the energy of every insult you have ever endured. Getting hit tops it up. It never needs charging.
items.synergy_notes: Juggernaut build: rewards standing in melee. Pairs with Hazard Vest and Iron Gut.

items.name: Novelty Vampire Straw
items.description: A bendy straw with fangs. You are told not to ask what it was used for previously. You ask anyway. You regret it.
items.synergy_notes: Universal sustain; strongest with fast-killing builds (scattergun, maul).

items.name: Last-Gasp Adrenaline
items.description: An auto-injector that only fires when your vital signs become 'commercially interesting'.
items.synergy_notes: High-risk build enabler: below 35% HP all attacks are 20% faster. Dangerous with Spite Battery.

items.name: Sponsor's Stopwatch
items.description: Engraved with the words 'Time is money'. It has opinions about how you spend both.
items.synergy_notes: Clock-runner build. Flagged: watch for collapse-clock trivialisation alongside the Time Pouch.

items.name: Golden Participation Trophy
items.description: Awarded for showing up. The viewers voted. The vote was not close, and nobody will say which way it went.
items.synergy_notes: Build-agnostic legendary. Strong but not mandatory: no build depends on it.

items.name: Roll of Sponsored Bandages
items.description: Each bandage is printed with an advertisement. The adhesive is surprisingly good.
items.synergy_notes: Basic heal for every build.

items.name: Deluxe Medkit (Sample Size)
items.description: Contains gauze, antiseptic and a coupon for 10% off your next catastrophic injury.
items.synergy_notes: Bigger heal for deeper floors.

items.name: Sketchy Antidote
items.description: The label has been scratched off and replaced with a hand-drawn smiley face. It works. Mostly.
items.synergy_notes: Counter to poison and bleed enemies.

items.name: Speed Draught
items.description: Tastes like an energy drink that was left in a hot car for a decade. The side effects are mostly lateral.
items.synergy_notes: Short haste burst; useful to cross a room before the clock ticks.

items.name: Collapse Tick Shard
items.description: A splinter of the floor's own countdown, still faintly ticking. Swallowing it is technically allowed.
items.synergy_notes: Clock buffer. Kept out of normal room drops so it cannot be farmed.

items.name: Flash-Bang Party Popper
items.description: Congratulations! You have been selected for a surprise celebration. So has everything within arm's reach.
items.synergy_notes: Emergency crowd control for any build.
